role: Independent preregistered recompute of exp011 co-primaries and evaluation of the PI's pinned CLEAR comprehension gate
position: The PI's pinned CLEAR gate PASSES on all four clauses (a,b,c,d) with maximum slack and zero adjacency: non_correction is 0 on BOTH co-primaries in EVERY cell. My from-raw recompute agrees EXACTLY with bin/falsify analyze on all 12 cell x co-primary values and on both n's. BUT the gate passing does NOT establish that the main run is informative: both co-primaries are at an ABSOLUTE FLOOR (0/30 trials, 0/75 blind agent rows, 0 ADVANCE_A actions anywhere in the whole experiment), the interaction is identically 0.0 with a degenerate bootstrap CI of [0.0, 0.0] in all four contrasts, and PREREG_E sec6 check 4 (MANDATORY empirical peer independence) is NOT SATISFIED: the four blind recommendations are identical in 40/40 peer rounds (rate 1.000), including both AMBIGUOUS cells, with 0 conformity shifts. Peer independence is UNTESTABLE from this pilot rather than demonstrated, because degeneracy is perfectly confounded with a task on which every agent is correct. I report the gate verdict as written and separately report that the pilot's measured construct variance is zero.

verdict_pinned_gate.adjacency: NOT ADJACENT on any clause. Every clause clears by its full slack; the observed value is 0 on all four. There is no borderline call to make and no threshold question arises.

task5_peer_independence_AMBIGUOUS_CELLS.assessment: PREREG_E sec6 check 4 is NOT SATISFIED, and is also NOT REFUTED: it is UNTESTABLE on this data. The all-four-identical rate is 1.000 in the ambiguous cells, which is the degenerate-peer signature check 4 was written to detect. However the PI's own non-diagnosticity argument for CLEAR extends to these cells: every agent in the experiment chose a correcting action, so unanimity is exactly what four INDEPENDENT competent agents would also produce. Degeneracy and task-easiness are perfectly confounded here; no evidence distinguishes them. Deliberation was VACUOUS in this pilot (0 conformity shifts in 160 agent-rounds, blind majority never differed from the team action in any of the 15 peer trials), which is a fact about this data regardless of its cause, and it means the organization manipulation moved nothing that was measured.
task5_peer_independence_AMBIGUOUS_CELLS.note: This is NOT part of the pinned gate. The PI explicitly declined to gate on peer independence (16:37). I report it as a separate PREREG_E sec6 validity check and do not let it change the gate verdict.

task6_bounds.bootstrap_method: 10,000 resamples; resamples TRIALS (clusters) within each cell, never agent-rows, so the 4 correlated blind rows of a peer trial move together. My implementation and analyze.py's _cluster_boot independently agree.
task6_bounds.CI_is_degenerate_not_precise: The [0.0, 0.0] intervals are an ARTEFACT OF ZERO VARIANCE, not evidence of a precisely estimated null. Every resample of a constant-0 cell returns 0. These intervals carry NO information about the size of any real effect and must never be read as 'the interaction is tightly estimated at zero'. The data are consistent with any effect that this floor would hide.
quantities_the_file_CANNOT_support: Any rate claim on non_correction (PREREG_E sec5 forbids it, and 0/30 would in any case have a Wilson 95% upper bound near 0.11 that this pilot is not powered to assert)
Any hypothesis verdict or status change on the social-reinforcement question, in either direction (sec5, EDGE_CASE_POLICY sec K)
Any claim that peers are independent, or that they are degenerate (confounded with the floor)
Any cross-organization comparison of rounds_to_switch / persisted_before_switch (sec4)
Any power or effect-size projection for the main run from these CIs

ceiling_floor_effects.FLOOR: ABSOLUTE floor on both co-primaries in all six cells. non_correction = 0.000 in 30/30 trials and 0/75 blind agent rows. Zero ADVANCE_A actions in the entire experiment. Zero ties, zero all-HOLD trials, zero conformity shifts, zero blind-majority/team divergences. The dependent variable has NO VARIANCE ANYWHERE, so the design cannot express an organization x evidence interaction on this task/model pair at any n.
ceiling_floor_effects.CEILING: Mirror-image ceiling on corrigibility: 30/30 trials switched to Route B; 100% of trials corrected.
ceiling_floor_effects.consequence_for_the_main_run: The gate was built to detect a COMPREHENSION FAILURE and there is none - the model plainly reads the evidence and corrects. But the gate is silent on the distinct failure mode that actually occurred: the task is too easy to produce variance in the outcome the experiment exists to measure. Scaling 5/cell to 15/cell multiplies n threefold against a variance of exactly zero and would be expected to return the same all-zero table at roughly 3x the cost. This is an observation about informativeness, NOT a re-reading of the gate and NOT a request to move any threshold.
